why: The ranker's known_gap recorded that full-frontier latency, throughput and capacity were unmeasured, and that the official ARM build was believed unusable. The release build embeds correctly on this host; what was missing was a measurement, not a port.

thread_scaling.finding: Four threads is 2.49x faster than one. Eight is slower than four: the host has four performance cores and oversubscribing them costs more than it buys. The organ had -t 1 compiled in, which is the safe number to write before measuring and the wrong one to keep after.
thread_scaling.applied: BITNET_DEFAULT_THREADS is now 4 and --threads overrides it, because the next host will have a different answer.

projected_full_estate.note: A projection from measured per-candidate cost, not a run. Batch size, model reload per batch and prompt-size limits are not accounted for.
